amendment_reason: The user-authorized node wall is strictly four hours, while receiver throughput is unmeasured. This preregistered three-epoch screen preserves several complete epochs and leaves margin for receiver acceptance, evaluation, cleanup, and publication.

amendment_scope.interpretation: reduced optimization budget; not an R1 twelve-epoch result
amendment_scope.learning_rate_schedule: same WSD schedule and warmup/cooldown fractions over the shorter configured horizon

arms.knots: 17 uniform from fitting min to max
priority reservoir 131072 rows seed221022; quantiles k/16 with full-fitting min/max endpoints

membership.fit: all eligible whole fitting components from the existing full fold manifests
membership.evaluation: unchanged complete evaluation components from each same fold manifest

representation.basis_projection: flatten112x16 then linear1792->256 and add to raw/event token projection
representation.nonfinite: zero imputation then event99, plus missing112 indicator; 323 common inputs

backbone.context_semantics: 256 per layer; effective receptive field up to 1021

optimizer.name: AdamW
optimizer.schedule: WSD linear warmup / stable / linear cooldown

metric.aggregation: full components, full fold; equal cell mean

bootstrap.fold_rng: independent fold substreams from master seed

required_profiles.identity: one unique approved strict-FP32 B300 four-update receipt for every R2 cell/config

blocking_dependencies: bind actual receiver source data and F0/F2 split hashes
pass documented non-ML receiver tests and exact-config real-device profiles
verify all six fitted/evaluated cells fit within the remaining strict node wall

scientific_contract.all_unmodified_recipe_semantics: identical to R1: full fitting components, preprocessing, seed/cell membership, model inputs, objective, masks, global batch, one-GPU world size, FP32 precision, metric, paired bootstrap and decision threshold
scientific_contract.epoch_change: the sole scientific budget change is twelve to three complete epochs
scientific_contract.do_not_claim: R1 equivalence, twelve-epoch quality, measured runtime, unseen-fold generalization, significance, or public score
